provider.name: GeoNames
provider.organization_type: global geographic name, gazetteer, administrative hierarchy, postal code, timezone, elevation, map, linked-data, bulk-download, and web-service platform
provider.description: GeoNames is a global geographic database containing place names, coordinates, feature classifications, country and administrative codes, population, elevation, timezones, alternate names, postal codes, hierarchy relationships, and linked-data identifiers.
institutional_context: National mapping, statistical, postal, and geographic data providers
Creative Commons and open geospatial data ecosystem
Linked-data, GIS, geocoding, and web-service consumers

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting GeoNames documentation, bulk gazetteer and postal-code dumps, field formats, feature and administrative codes, alternate names, hierarchy, web services, linked data, licensing, citation, data quality, and account guidance.
purpose.authoritative_notice: GeoNames and its cited source datasets remain authoritative for GeoNames identifiers, records, web services, dumps, licenses, terms, release files, and contact information.
